info.name: Mastiska API
info.description:
End-to-end tests for Mastiska: auth, bookmarks + ingestion, tags, collections, notes, search, ask, assistant.

Run the whole collection with the Collection Runner (requests chain ids via collection variables; the "Wait until…" and "Ask until rate limited" requests loop with setNextRequest). Needs the API on {{baseUrl}} with Postgres, Redis and GEMINI_API_KEY configured.
